about.text: A yoghurt from the water buffalo milk of the Afyon region of Turkey, with a geographical indication application listed in a review. The industrial version is heated to 90 to 95 °C for 5 to 10 minutes, then incubated at 42 to 45 °C for 3 to 5 hours.

sources.text: Its Afyon buffalo milk and its geographical indication status, from these.
